title: Silvia
bio: Silvia is a high school student with a deep interest in classics and languages, notably Spanish and Latin. She loves exploring the overlap of her subjects and aims to connect others to these fields.

title: Imelda
eyebrow: "No risk, no story" from West Africa
bio: My name is Imelda. I am from Burkina Faso, West Africa. My favorite food is "futu banana et sauce graine." I enjoy watching funny videos on Instagram, riding motorbikes, playing basketball, and travelling. I also love dancing to Afrobeat and Amapiano and being there for myself. I feel honored to be able to share about my country and I hope you will enjoy it! Small side quote (my favorite quote) "No risk, no story"

title: Keiko
bio: Hello! I’m Keiko, a rising senior from Los Angeles CA! I currently serve as the Student Member on the Alhambra USD Board of Education and as the Founder & CEO of More Than a Number, an organization dedicated to collecting testimonials from child marriage survivors. My passion lies at the intersection of human rights, education, and the literary arts, and I aspire to become a human rights lawyer and author. Beyond my advocacy for educational equity and social justice, I serve as an Emissary at the USC Shoah Foundation. In my free time, I love to read, write, and spend time with my cat, Mochi!

title: Jamia
eyebrow: Haitian American driven to amplify underrepresented voices
bio: Jamia is a Haitian American with a deep appreciation for journalism, history, and writing. She is driven by a commitment to amplify underrepresented voices.

title: Mariia
eyebrow: Ukraine Global Scholar & Rebuild Ukraine Ambassador
bio: Hello! My name is Mariia, but you can call me Masha as well. I am from Odesa, Ukraine. This year I have graduated from the high school and it’s time to decide where I am going to spend the next 4 years of my life! I am passionate about human rights, global studies and public policy! I am also a Rebuild Ukraine Ambassador on the European Youth Parliament Network and a volunteer. It is nice to share my experience with you here :)

title: Keyla
eyebrow: Fueled by faith, driven by purpose, inspired by people
bio: My name is Keyla, a proud Rwandan passionate about international relations, business, technology, and fashion. I value diversity and the richness it brings to global conversations. I’m deeply interested in building inclusive communities and connecting with people from all backgrounds. I love engaging in dialogue, learning from different perspectives, and using technology as a bridge across cultures. When I’m not studying or exploring new ideas, you’ll find me praying, reading, playing basketball, expressing myself through fashion, and spending quality time with my people. I believe in the power of faith, connection and community

title: Aaliyah
bio: Hi everyone! My name is Aaliyah, I’m from Brooklyn, New York but I lived in Long Island, New York for most of my life! I have a small business where I sell handmade crocheted and knitted products. I’m also a first- generation American, my family comes from a small island in the West Indies called Grenada!

title: Naj
bio: My name is Naj, a high school student and I am happy to serve as Outreach Specialist for Classic Compass.

title: Mariam
bio: My name is Mariam, and I am a high school student, am active in theater, school store, spirit council, black history and women history month committee etc. I have a passion for graphic design and arts. I am a first grandchild born in America, planning on becoming a doctor so that when I visit my family in Tanzania, I can help them with any health problems they may have.

title: Asheen
bio: Asheen Udgiri is a youth leader, public health advocate, and Commissioner on Pennsylvania’s Governor’s Advisory Commission on Next Generation Engagement. Named the American Heart Association’s 2025 Teen of Impact, she raised over $39,000 through Mission AED to expand defibrillator access. As Vice President of Hear Erie’s Youth, she has helped allocate over $70,000 in community grants. An 18 Under 18 honoree, Asheen also advocates for mental health access, equity, and student leadership across Pennsylvania.
